tickets.description: Tickets to classify. `ticket_id` values must be unique within the array. Uniqueness of ticket_id cannot be expressed in JSON Schema and is checked by the service.

Channel.description: How the ticket arrived. This is an input field, not a label.

ticket_id.description:
Optional identifier for `/predict` (required for `/predict/batch` and `/batch/jobs`). If provided, echo
it back in the response. Do not use it as a model feature (IDs carry no signal and the
harness uses opaque values).

subject.description: Email subject line. Empty string or omitted for chat and call transcripts.

text.description:
Ticket body, chat messages joined by newlines, or the call transcript. UTF-8.
Must contain at least one non-whitespace character, otherwise return `422`.
Emoji-only and mixed-script text is valid.
